prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Subscription box billing backend
client: Fernwood Pantry
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2025-07
end: 2025-10
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Node.js
- NestJS
- PostgreSQL
- Stripe Billing
- BullMQ
implied_skills:
- recurring billing
- background jobs
built: Moved subscribers off a legacy plugin onto Stripe Billing with a retry queue
  for failed card payments.
metrics:
- 6.5k subscribers migrated
- 31% of failed payments recovered

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: business impact.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "Fernwood Pantry".
- Never use these words or phrases: "recurring billing", "background jobs". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
